LEAD: summarise the candidate-branch adaptations (code, tests, workflow, packaging) once the final commit exists
lead_note: Every string that begins 'LEAD:' is a placeholder. Replace it with a value read back from a real commit or run, or remove the field. Delete this note when none remain. A commit cannot name itself, so the final commit that carries this file is recorded in docs/clarify-candidate/HANDOFF.md.

candidate.tested_commit: LEAD: the commit the verifying Actions run executed against
candidate.changes: LEAD: one-line summary of the meaningful candidate changes (detail in docs/clarify-candidate/HANDOFF.md)

native_windows_status: not verified: the baseline run failed and no candidate run has passed

native_windows_runs.role: baseline of the unmodified candidate; not a pass

windows_artifact.run_url: LEAD: Actions run that built and tested the artifact
windows_artifact.sha256: LEAD: SHA-256 of the exact packaged bytes that were tested
windows_artifact.runtime_prerequisites: LEAD: what the artifact needs on the machine it runs on
windows_artifact.signing: unsigned: not Nous-signed and not a verified installer
